en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard with a photograph on the left and handwritten message on the right. The photo shows a woman standing by a rocky spring or cliff in a wooded landscape. At the bottom of the image is the caption "Parikkalan Lähteellä." Along the left border is printed "H. Heinosen Kirjakauppa." The right half is filled with cursive handwriting in Finnish, dated 1914 at the top.
